recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中可見數團深藍色、緊密黏合的腫瘤細胞團塊，與周圍分散的造血細胞截然不同，這種黏合性細胞團是轉移性神經母細胞瘤（metastatic neuroblastoma）侵犯骨髓的線索。
features: Several tight, cohesive clusters of dark-blue small cells distinct from dispersed marrow cells
Cells within clusters show nuclear crowding and molding with scant cytoplasm
A larger elongated central aggregate and smaller clusters at the left and right edges
Background of dispersed hematopoietic cells and red cell streaks
Rosettes or neuropil cannot be assessed at this low magnification
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows several tightly cohesive clusters of small, dark-blue cells with nuclear crowding, contrasting with the surrounding dispersed hematopoietic cells and red cells. The largest aggregate is elongated and centrally located, with smaller clumps at the edges of the field. Homer Wright rosettes, neuritic fibrillary material and fine nuclear detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a metastatic small round cell tumor, compatible with neuroblastoma; confirmation with biopsy immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Clumped marrow particles contain a mixture of maturing lineages and fat, whereas tumor clusters are monotonous with nuclear molding.
Other small round cell tumors can form clusters and are separated by desmin/myogenin or CD99/NKX2.2 immunostaining.
Leukemic blasts are discohesive and diffusely replace the marrow rather than forming tight cohesive clusters.
